privacyLabel: Runs in your browser. Your input is never uploaded or saved.
inputDescription: Paste your configuration or import a file.
outputDescription: Updates as you type. Values stay strings.
outputPlaceholder: Your converted configuration will appear here…
fileErrorLabel: Could not read this file. Try again or paste its contents.
rulesLabel: Comments and formatting are not carried over. Variable references such as ${NAME} stay literal.

diagnostics.assignment: Expected KEY=value. Add an equals sign.
diagnostics.invalidKey: Invalid key “{key}”. Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.
diagnostics.duplicate: Duplicate key “{key}” (first defined on line {previousLine}). The last definition is used.
diagnostics.unclosedQuote: Missing closing {quote} quote for “{key}”. Close the quote, including for multiline values.
diagnostics.trailingText: Unexpected text after the closing quote for “{key}”. Remove it or start a comment with #.
diagnostics.smartQuote: “{key}” uses curly quotes. Replace them with straight quotes if you intended a quoted value.
diagnostics.rootObject: Use a flat object of environment variables, such as {"PORT": "3000"}.
diagnostics.invalidValue: “{key}” must be a string, number or boolean. Replace null, arrays and nested objects with a string.
diagnostics.syntax: Invalid {format}. Check the syntax and make sure each key appears only once.
diagnostics.unrepresentable: “{key}” cannot be written as .env without changing its value. Simplify its quotes or line breaks.
